text:
marie: Quick sync — GA readiness for next inference milestone. Need clear owners for SLA, docs, monitoring, support playbooks, and pricing triggers. Who takes what?
kevin: I can own SLA + rollback/escape-hatch wording. We need explicit SLOs for Hosted vs Dedicated (p50/p95/p99).
josh: Monitoring + alerts are mine. Plan to ship an SLI dashboard, two runbooks: latency spike and token quota exhaustion.
lisa: Docs owner. I'll stage public GA docs under /docs/ga/inference and internal runbooks in Confluence. Need final telemetry field names for examples.
marie: Two constraints: Legal requires opt-in 30-day log retention for Private, FinOps wants a pricing floor on burst buckets to avoid negative margins.
kevin: Proposed SLOs: Hosted: p95 <= 220ms (short prompts), p99 <= 850ms with defined fallback. Dedicated: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms. Thoughts?
josh: Reasonable. Need variance analysis for long-context (>4096) workloads. I'll add a sequence-length heatmap and propose an alert: persistent_p99_up_10pct_over_15m -> pager.
marie: Kevin, include fallback chain in SLA doc: model-variant -> region-failover -> degraded-mode, with customer-facing messaging per step.
kevin: Will include table of degradations and exact customer notices.
lisa: Paste the telemetry fields please — I need them for docs and troubleshooting.
josh: Minimal set: model_name, model_variant, seq_len, tokens_generated, latency_ms, shard_id, region, customer_tier, cache_hit.
marie: Use those. Also add a curl smoke-check example in docs.
lisa: Draft snippet: ```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/generate | jq .
```
kevin: Support playbooks: three tiers — L1 triage (console + logs), L2 (fallbacks & routing), L3 (capacity/kernel). I'll map oncall rotations.
sam: Pricing: add burst-surcharge when Dedicated pool utilization >85% for 5m. Surcharge configurable per-customer, min +20% over base. I'll draft calculation examples and API toggles.
marie: Also include an early-adopter promo toggle we can flip at GA. Sam, can you add CLI & API examples?
sam: Yep, I'll add preview tool showing cost impact.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging smoke-run at 1778312700 — 0.6% p99 regressions vs baseline, no infra errors. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Blockers: (1) Legal sign-off on retention; (2) SRE sign-off on region-failover test plan.
josh: Scheduling region failover test Wed 09:00 PT. Test checklist: drain -> reroute -> validate latencies -> rollback. I'll invite SRE and do a dry-run.
lisa: Docs staging: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFER/GA+Docs+Staging (internal). Ping for editorial reviews.
marie: Action items and owners: Kevin -> SLA + escape-hatches (due EOD Fri). Josh -> monitoring dashboards + failover plan (due Tue). Lisa -> public GA docs draft + troubleshooting (due Thu). Sam -> pricing examples + promo toggle API (due Thu). Confirm?
kevin: Confirmed.
josh: Confirmed.
lisa: Confirmed.
sam: Confirmed.
marie: OK if no objections by EOD we'll lock owners and send one-pager to PM/Legal/FinOps. :rocket:
